t: Speech to Text: Voice Commands and Instant Formatting
Fill your emails and notes by voice in the browser, apply custom commands and smart formatting rules, then copy the result instantly without signing in or sending data to any server.
Turn your speech into ready-to-use text in one click

Yes, you can start in seconds: allow the microphone, press the start button, then speak naturally; your words appear in the box instantly, and you can turn your agreed phrases into ready-made templates and simple symbols into headings and lists before copying the result. There's no sign-in, nothing is stored in the browser, and nothing is sent to a server; everything stays on this page until you close it. Add your favorite command to the command list, try the formatting rules, then copy the final text into your email, document, or the reply tool you use every day. If you want another try, press the button again and keep going; a little practice phrasing commands saves typing time and reduces mistakes.
Say the phrase while dictating to replace it with the saved wording.
No. Open the page, allow the microphone, and start; nothing is saved after you close the tab.
It isn't sent to a server. The text stays in the page's temporary memory until you copy it or close the page.
What should I do if the microphone doesn't work?
Try a modern browser, make sure the page is allowed to use the microphone, then press the start button again. If recognition isn't available, you can type directly and apply the rules.
How do I use custom commands?
Type the phrase in the command field and its wording in the template field, then say the phrase while dictating; the template will be inserted in its place.
Yes, press the Select text to copy button; the text will be selected automatically and you can paste it into any app you use.
